description: This file defines an interface for diagnostics related to log consistency in Orleans grains, as well as a data class for log consistency statistics.

classes.name: ILogConsistencyDiagnostics
classes.description: An interface providing diagnostic methods for enabling/disabling statistics collection and retrieving statistics for log-consistent grains in Orleans.

classes.name: LogConsistencyStatistics
classes.description: A class encapsulating statistics such as event counters and stabilization latencies for log-consistent grains.

methods.name: EnableStatsCollection
methods.description: Enables statistics collection for the log-consistent grain.

methods.name: DisableStatsCollection
methods.description: Disables statistics collection for the log-consistent grain.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Retrieves the collected log consistency statistics.
